_comment: Facet taxonomy for the unified AMCR u TEATER vocabulary.
Keys starting with '_' are never treated as facets.
teater_branch_map TEATER branch -> facet, resolved MOST-SPECIFIC FIRST
along the term's broader chain, so a depth-2 sub-branch
keyword match     legacy substring fallback; fires for nothing today
Every placement is recorded in *_placement_audit.csv with the rule that made
it, so the mapping can be reviewed instead of trusted. Sort that file by
'scheme' to correct a whole source list at once.
'__exclude__' drops the term from the vocabulary entirely; see _exclusions
for why each list is dropped.
FACET ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING. build_system_prompt truncates a *prefix* of the
flattened term list, so priority decides what a small-context model keeps.
Chronology/Area/Feature/Artefact lead because that is what a report line is
most often about; Documentation and Location & Admin go last on purpose.

heslar_labels renames AMCR's machine list names for the prompt sub-header: the model reads 'Chronology / období (kategorie)', not 'Chronology / obdobi_kat'. TEATER's depth-2 labels are already human-readable and pass through unchanged.

teater_branch_labels.1: 1) Teorie a přístupy / Theory and approaches
teater_branch_labels.288: 4) Hraniční obory / Cross-border and related disciplines
teater_branch_labels.2900: 10.3) historické oblasti a státní útvary / historical regions
teater_branch_labels.3094: 11) Povolání a pracovní činnosti / Professions and work activities

_exclusions.zeme: 249 country names. The prompt header forbids selecting one; they must not be offered.
_exclusions.letiste: 29 airfield place names, used only as aerial-survey provenance.
_exclusions.dohlednost: 12 visibility bands — survey conditions, not a topic.
_exclusions.nalez_typ: only 2 members, 'objekt' and 'předmět' — the top of the type hierarchy sitting as siblings of real find types, i.e. an always-correct escape hatch.
_exclusions.dok_jednotka_typ: 4 documentation-unit names (katastrální území, lokalita) — spatial/admin units, not methods.
_exclusions.projekt_typ: 3 bare adjectives (badatelský, průzkum, záchranný) — meaningless as standalone categories.
_exclusions.datum_specifikace: 3 date-precision qualifiers (přesné datum, někdy v letech) — qualifiers, not periods.
_exclusions.jistota_urceni: confidence percentages (jisté > 95 %) — an epistemic qualifier; confidence_score already carries this.
_exclusions.letfoto_tvar: 16 aerial cropmark shapes (ohrazení kruhové malé) — a remote-sensing observation vocabulary, not a site or feature class.
_exclusions.TEATER 1: Theory and approaches — the discipline talking about itself.
_exclusions.TEATER 288: 959 concepts of neighbouring disciplines — the single largest branch, and almost none of it is report vocabulary.
_exclusions.TEATER 2557: 740 ethnonyms, historical regions, dynasties, battles and wars. Keyed per sub-branch below so 'etnika' (2560) can be reinstated on its own.
_exclusions.objekt_specifikace_kat: 2 field names, not concepts: 'způsob provedení', 'těžený/zpracovávaný materiál'.

Activity Area._comment: Areas defined by the activity carried out there: settlement, burial, cult, production, mining, military.

Feature._comment: Physical features and structures, and how they are built.

Material._comment: What an object or feature is made of.

Finds Context._comment: The deposition circumstances a find was recovered from.

Documentation._comment: Document types, carriers, custody and condition.

Other._comment: Terms no rule placed. Empty in every current build — with heslar_map and teater_branch_map in force nothing falls through. A non-empty Other means a source added a list the maps do not cover; treat it as a build failure to investigate, not a bucket to hide things in.
